boundedExecution.note: Passing tests assert observations including missing features; they are not native or full-row acceptance. No whole suite rerun.

constraints: Read-only application review; only owned tmp directory written; no native/provider/paid-model/AWS/commit/push actions.

confirmedFindings.title: Saved client detail fields have no on-screen read-only profile surface
confirmedFindings.observation: Overview renders name, raw profileStatus, raw sectorTag, website and description, but no saved location/contact/government details. The Government info summary/dialog in the design is absent. A standard_user can read the client record but Edit client profile is disabled, so this user cannot inspect these fields on screen; JSON export is a separate possible workaround. The same fixture also shows HOMELAND_SECURITY and ACTIVE instead of display labels.
reproduction: Serve the unchanged Portfolio fixture at 5191.
Run review.spec.ts second case: provide standard_user and a client containing Costa Mesa, contact name/email/phone, CAGE and UEI.
Open client Overview and More actions. All six saved values and Government info are absent; Edit is disabled.
confirmedFindings.deploymentImpact: Incomplete CORE-013 feature/design acceptance. No crash, authority bypass or destructive effect was observed; this does not independently establish an infrastructure rollout blocker.
confirmedFindings.confidence: confirmed by source and synthetic browser

confirmedFindings.title: Client view switcher omits search and the specified per-view keyboard shortcuts
confirmedFindings.observation: Figma specifies Jump to a view search, decorated rows and G O/G J/G C etc. The source renders nine bare links and only binds Ctrl/Meta+J to toggle the menu. No search input or G-sequence handling exists. Ordinary menu-click navigation works. Missing routes such as standalone Timeline/Outreach are not asserted as new required endpoints here.
reproduction: Press Ctrl+J: menu opens with nine menuitems and zero textboxes.
Press Escape, then G then C: route stays on Overview. Selecting Calendar by click navigates correctly.
confirmedFindings.deploymentImpact: Blocks full CORE-121 interaction/design parity; no backend dependency prevents local search or shortcuts to existing views. Not a demonstrated infrastructure rollout blocker.
confirmedFindings.confidence: confirmed by source and synthetic browser

confirmedFindings.title: Account team retains a generic stacked form instead of the designed roster
confirmedFindings.observation: The design shows Account team plus client name, avatar/email roster details, row separators and side-by-side member/role controls. Current exact-source screenshot shows a generic Account team heading, name/role-only roster and full-width stacked member/role/add controls. The renderer omits the available email field. Manage owners is an intentional extra entry and the completed Owners repair is not reopened.
reproduction: Inspect exact-source team-1440.png or open Account team on a client with a current roster.
Compare the roster and add-member form with Figma411:51801.
confirmedFindings.deploymentImpact: Lower-priority presentation parity; no team-write regression or unsafe behavior claimed.
confirmedFindings.confidence: confirmed source plus exact-source archived render

confirmedFindings.title: Intake choice groups use one three-column grid for distinct designed layouts
confirmedFindings.observation: The common ChoiceList grid forces three columns. At 1440px the six certification options wrap into 3x2 instead of the design single row; submission tracks become 3x2 instead of the design 2x3; Foreign-owned does not span the business-classification row. These supplemental editor frames are the references documented by INTAKE-CHECKPOINT, distinct from the read-only Government info frame linked by the ledger.
reproduction: Open Add profile > Manual entry at 1440x1040.
Visit Company Info, Government Registration, Sector & Tracks without saving.
Compare group geometry against supplemental editor frames.
confirmedFindings.deploymentImpact: Lower-priority desktop form parity. Fields, step changes and cancel work in the bounded probe; no value or persistence regression claimed.
confirmedFindings.confidence: confirmed source and fresh synthetic render

deploymentConclusion: No independently confirmed P0/P1 or infrastructure deployment blocker in this bounded slice. Two P2 feature gaps and two P3 visual gaps prevent full design/feature acceptance for their rows. CORE-077 Checkout semantics need current backend/Settings owner resolution before payment activation is treated as accepted. This is not native acceptance.
